description.value: SunTea Canada is a BC-based bubble tea chain specializing in fresh-brewed fruit teas and milk teas, with locations across the Lower Mainland and into Alberta. The brand has operated since 2019 and offers a loyalty rewards app and online ordering for in-store pickup. If operational, this Richmond location would sit on a major arterial road convenient to urban cycling routes.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 17m; rack at 37m; rack at 51m; rack at 62m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms SunTea Canada is a real, operating bubble tea chain (13 stores across BC and AB, fresh brewed since 2019) and the domain sunteabc.com matches the OSM URL. However, the OSM address (10111 Number 3 Road, Unit 130, Richmond) does not appear in the 13 locations listed on the /orders page — neither Richmond location (Ackroyd Rd #140 or 4540 No.3 Rd #1465) matches, raising doubt that this specific location is currently open. The OSM name 'SunTea Bakery' also mismatches the brand name 'SunTea Canada' and none of the store names include 'Bakery'; online ordering for pickup confirms takeout, but no cycling-specific amenity information appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM address (10111 Number 3 Road, Unit 130, Richmond) is not listed among the 13 SunTea Canada stores on the website's /orders page. The two listed Richmond locations are at 8211 Ackroyd Rd #140 and 4540 No.3 Rd #1465 — neither matches.

OSM name 'SunTea Bakery' does not match the brand name 'SunTea Canada' or any of the individual store names (e.g. 'SunTea Ackroyd Richmond', 'SunTea Empire Richmond'). 'Bakery' may indicate a different or former business at this address.
No phone number in OSM or on website.
